Explicitly distinguish a strictly germ-local retention from a finite-reference-memory realization, a local jet evaluation from a finite global encoding of arbitrary sections, and conditional finite-generator subfamilies. target.falsification_criterion: Complete affirmative closure requires all locality, memory, normalization, dynamics, history and geometry conjuncts on the declared class. A finite-reference result or finite-generator family is conditional and does not settle strictly local realization on arbitrary published sections. A negative closure requires a nonexistence proof covering every allowed realization, not a failed jet ansatz.
